questions.stem: A patient came to the hospital with complaints of lethargy, increased sleep, and weight gain. Investigations revealed low plasma TSH concentration. However, on the ​administration of TRH, the TSH levels increased. Which of the following conditions is likely in this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Hyperthyroidism due to disease in the pituitary

options.label: B
options.text: Hypothyroidism due to disease in the pituitary

options.label: C
options.text: Hypothyroidism due to disease in the hypothalamus

options.label: D
options.text: Hyperthyroidism due to disease in the hypothalamus
